chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yazeed, who said:
Whenever a snake or a scorpion stung a person from the household, he said: 'Make him drink apple suweeq (porridge/paste).'

key_terms.سَوِيقَ: Suweeq (a type of porridge or thick paste made from flour and liquid)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended remedy for snake or scorpion bites according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kulayni’s *Al-Kafi*, this hadith illustrates the Prophetic tradition of utilizing natural remedies within the domestic sphere, specifically prescribing apple porridge (*suweeq al-tuffah*) for envenomation. It reflects the Shia scholarly view that the Imams possessed comprehensive knowledge of both spiritual and physical healing, integrating dietary therapy with divine guidance to address immediate health crises.
